WebSearch “فوڈ ٹرک آن لائن آرڈر سسٹم پاکستان” — no Pakistani food-truck ordering product; market: foodpanda, Cheetay, Eat Mubarak, own websites and WhatsApp ordering; high aggregator commission pushes “commission-free” own ordering (blinkco, oscar.pk)

WebSearch “"ٹیک اوے" … کیش آن ڈیلیوری فوڈ پانڈا” — Pakistan is a cash-on-delivery market (Mastercard–foodpanda 2025 and Karandaaz 2023 partnerships to move COD users to digital); foodpanda pick-up = takeaway; Eat Mubarak takeaway paid by card, wallet or cash

WebSearch “"فوڈ ٹرک" لاہور کراچی کاروبار” — Dawn, The News, Express Tribune, Brandsynario: food trucks established in Karachi (Bao Bae, Eat Truck Co, Street Dudes), few in Lahore; all coverage in English
confidence: Low-Med — address form, آرڈر/مینو/کچن ڈسپلے/کمیشن/مفت ٹرائل/ایپ/گاہک are confirmed on an Urdu vendor page and the COD trap is well documented; فوڈ ٹرک, پک اپ, ٹیک اوے, پری آرڈر are the standard Urdu-script transliterations but no Pakistani Urdu food-truck page was found to confirm them (Pakistani food-truck coverage is in English). No search-volume tool: Pakistanis mostly search in English or Roman Urdu (“food truck business in pakistan”); Urdu-script searches are smaller. csvRows are the research tool’s (US-indexed) results for “فوڈ ٹرک آن لائن آرڈر سسٹم پاکستان”.
decisions: Pay at Hatch: “پک اپ پر ادائیگی” (feature) / “ٹرک پر ادائیگی” (label). Must NOT be “کیش آن ڈیلیوری”/COD — COD is the habit Pakistani apps are trying to move away from, and there is no delivery. Payment at the truck can be cash, card or a wallet (JazzCash/Easypaisa).
Combo: Pakistani fast-food menus say “Deal” (ڈیل) far more than “combo” — recommend ڈیل; Dominic to confirm.
Plural of loan nouns: recommend English-style -س/-ز plurals as Urdu vendor copy does (ریسٹورنٹس، آرڈرز، فوڈ ٹرکس) rather than oblique فوڈ ٹرکوں.
Takeaway spelling: ٹیک اوے (Pakistani/British usage), not MENU TIGER’s ٹیک آؤٹ (US).
Script/direction: right to left, Urdu letters and punctuation (۔ ، ؟); ASCII digits (ur-PK Intl default is Latin digits) — keep typed digits ASCII too.
Order button: no statutory button wording found for Pakistan (not verified against the E-Commerce Policy 2019 or provincial consumer protection acts); market norm “آرڈر کریں” / “آرڈر کنفرم کریں”.
